1.0.0.en: First public release. Pair a Themo account to add floor-heating thermostats, set temperature and mode, and use heating state in Energy and Flows.

1.0.1.en: Themo brand color and wordmark, updated store description, and a public source repository.

1.0.2.en: App icon now uses the Themo wordmark on the purple brand gradient.

1.0.5.en: Fixed the app icon so the Themo wordmark shows on Homey’s purple brand color. Removed the developer website.

1.0.6.en: App icon now matches Homey’s mask format so the wordmark is visible.

1.0.7.en: Lifestyle product photo for the App Store listing, and more reliable error logging.
